node-1.label: A man in his 40s has a 3-month history of dark red circular lesions in his right axilla with severe pruritus.

node-2.label: Patient is a man in his 40s with a 3-month history of discrete, dark red, circular lesions in the right axilla and severe pruritus that wakes him at night.

node-3.label: Physical examination revealed 3 well-circumscribed, violaceous, annular patches without scale or erosion limited to the right axilla; no other lesions were noted on skin or mucous membranes; Wood lamp examination was negative.

node-4.label: Patient denied recent trauma, similar lesions, pain, blisters, or systemic symptoms (e.g., fever, chills); medical history was unremarkable; he noted no environmental triggers or new medications.

node-5.label: Treatment with over-the-counter hydrocortisone cream, ketoconazole cream, and discontinuation of underarm deodorant yielded no improvement.
